_comment: Read and written by the ground app (flighttest/calibration.py validates every save). Values marked measured/calibrated=false are placeholders, not measurements. Per-servo limits live here, not in code: the elevator servo has already been swapped once. us_full_deflection = microseconds from neutral that give the simulator's full surface deflection (aileron 25 deg, elevator 20 deg, rudder 25 deg); direction = +1 if a positive command moves the surface the simulator's positive way (aileron +: roll right; elevator +: nose down; rudder +: nose left).

imu._comment: body = board_to_body @ board. Body frame: x forward, y right, z down. Must be a signed permutation with determinant +1. Verified 19 Nov 2026 on battery with the flight firmware: level az -1.074 g, nose up ax +0.260 g, right wing down ay -0.304 g, yaw right +88 deg for ~90 deg (firmware/flight/README.md). Signed off by the researcher.

baro._comment: Ground pressure reference is captured on the arm command after warm-up, never at boot.

rail._comment: 5 V rail sensed through a ~2:1 divider on GPIO34 (ADC1). The ESP32 sends the voltage at the pin; rail_v = scale * adc_v + offset_v. Indicative until calibrated against a multimeter. The ADC is nonlinear below ~0.15 V and above ~3.0 V; a 2:1 divider puts 5 V near 2.5 V.
